description: This file defines an abstract base class for connection-related events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides common properties and methods for subclasses representing specific connectivity events, including JSON serialization and equality checks.

classes.name: AbstractConnectivityEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing generic connection-related events, providing standard properties like event type, connection ID, timestamp, headers, and serialization behavior.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection associated with the event.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the event if available.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no metadata by default.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as manifest string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to JSON, applying schema version and predicate filters.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to add specific payload data to JSON serialization.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on type, connection ID, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to support proper equality checks in inheritance.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on core properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation of the event.
